controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On March 1, 2026, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ... by and among the Company, Horizon Parent, L.P." ; "will be converted automatically into the right to receive $15.00 in cash, without interest, per share" ; "Approval by the stockholders of the Company was obtained on June 26, 2026. At 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on June 22, 2026, the waiting period under the HSR Act expired" ; "The Merger is currently expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027"

controles.affirmation: AES Puerto Rico n'a pas honore principal et interets des Series A le 1er juin 2023 ; restructuration de mars 2024 : 156 M$ echanges contre 112 M$ d'obligations et 44 M$ de preferentielles, qualifiee de troubled debt restructuring
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 Note 8 : "On June 1, 2023, AES Puerto Rico was unable to pay principal and interest obligations on its Series A Bond Loans due to insufficient funds resulting from financial difficulties at the business." ; "On March 5, 2024 ... the $156 million (including interest) of 6.625% Series A Bond Loans due 2026 was exchanged for $112 million of 6.625% senior secured bonds due January 2028 and $44 million of preferred shares" ; "accounted for as a troubled debt restructuring in accordance with ASC 470-60"

controles.affirmation: Litige PREPA Title III ouvert depuis plusieurs annees, non resolu a la date du 10-Q
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The Oversight Board filed for bankruptcy on behalf of PREPA under Title III in July 2017" ; "The mediation period was subsequently extended through October 31, 2026, reflecting the continuing efforts to resolve remaining matters under the Title III proceedings."

controles.affirmation: 29% de la capacite de generation repose sur le gaz naturel et 15% sur le charbon
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K 2025 (2026-03-02), section Fuel Costs : "29% of the capacity of our generation plants is fueled by natural gas." ; "15% of the capacity of our generation fleet is coal-fired." (la section s'intitule "Fuel Costs", pas "Fuel Cost Breakdown" ; la preuve de l'ATT cite une phrase en francais entre guillemets, ce qui n'est pas un verbatim)

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K 2025 identifie explicitement la sortie du charbon comme une tendance qui se deteriore pour la societe
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune formulation de ce type dans le 10-K 2025. Le mot "deteriorating" provient du champ interne "trend": "deteriorating" de data-lake/AES/risks/extracted.json (notation Mettrik), pas du depot. Le 10-K se limite a : "initiatives could also result in the early retirement of coal-fired generation facilities, which could result in stranded costs if regulators disallow full recovery of investments."
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-K 2025 signale que les initiatives climatiques peuvent entrainer la mise a l'arret anticipee de centrales au charbon et des couts echoues si les regulateurs refusent d'en autoriser la recuperation. (Supprimer l'attribution au 10-K d'une notation de tendance qui est une evaluation interne.)

controles.affirmation: Le 10-Q recense des contentieux reglementaires actifs sur les residus de combustion du charbon (CCR) et les GES, dont l'issue est qualifiee d'incertaine par la societe
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The CCR rule, current or proposed amendments to the federal CCR rule or state/territory CCR regulations, the results of groundwater monitoring data, or the outcome of CCR-related litigation could have a material impact on our business, financial condition, and results of operations." ; "The May 8, 2024 revisions to the CCR Rule are currently subject to legal challenges." ; "It is too early to determine the potential impact of these rules"

10-K 2025 : "The Renewables SBU has generation facilities in ten countries - the United States, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Panama, the Dominican Republic, Mexico, Bulgaria, Jordan, and the Netherlands." Les dix pays concernent la seule SBU Renewables. Le groupe opere en outre au Salvador (AES El Salvador, quatre distributeurs), a Porto Rico, au Vietnam (Mong Duong 2) et a des litiges fiscaux au Bresil.
controles.correction_proposee: La SBU Renewables dispose d'installations dans dix pays ; le groupe dans son ensemble est present dans un nombre superieur de pays, dont le Salvador, Porto Rico et le Vietnam.

controles.affirmation: Litiges fiscaux en cours au Bresil et au Salvador parmi les procedures aux montants non tous estimables
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 Note 9 : "(including but not limited to tax disputes in Brazil and El Salvador); and regulatory matters"

controles.affirmation: Le Department of Commerce applique depuis juin 2025 des droits AD/CVD sur les panneaux solaires importes d'Asie du Sud-Est
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Commerce then issued orders on June 24, 2025, implementing the AD/CVD rates, which will be subject to annual review by Commerce."

controles.affirmation: Les composants de stockage d'energie sont soumis a un tarif de 25% depuis le 1er janvier 2026, contre 7,5% auparavant
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The U.S. also maintains tariffs under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 on certain Chinese made lithium-ion batteries and related components utilized for energy storage systems, with such tariffs currently set at 25% effective January 1, 2026 (an increase from the previous rate of 7.5%)." Le tarif ne vise que les batteries et composants d'origine chinoise, pas les composants de stockage en general.
controles.correction_proposee: Les batteries lithium-ion et composants associes d'origine chinoise destines au stockage d'energie sont soumis a un tarif Section 301 de 25% depuis le 1er janvier 2026, contre 7,5% auparavant.

controles.affirmation: De nouvelles enquetes Section 301 et Section 232 visant la Chine, l'UE, la Coree du Sud et le graphite des batteries lithium-ion restaient en cours a la date du 10-Q
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In March 2026, the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative initiated investigations under Section 301 concerning possible persistent trade surpluses and unused capacity with respect to China, the EU, South Korea, and certain other major trading partners. These investigations are ongoing." MAIS pour le graphite : "In March 2026, the ITC issued a negative determination in its companion investigation, and therefore no AD/CVD orders will issue on anode material from China." L'enquete AD/CVD sur le graphite est close par une determination negative ; seule une Proclamation Section 232 de janvier 2026 sur les mineraux critiques (sans droits imposes) reste en cours.
controles.correction_proposee: Les enquetes Section 301 visant la Chine, l'UE et la Coree du Sud restaient en cours ; en revanche l'enquete AD/CVD sur le graphite chinois a ete close en mars 2026 par une determination negative de l'ITC, le graphite ne restant vise que par une Proclamation Section 232 de janvier 2026 qui n'impose aucun droit.
